question: Who among the following Indian classical musicians was known as ‘The Queen of Thumri’, who was bestowed the Padma Vibhushan in 2016 for her contribution to music?
solution:
The correct answer is **Girija Devi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **Girija Devi** was an Indian classical singer of the** Seniya and Banaras gharanas.**
 
• She performed classically and light classical music and helped elevate the **profile of thumri.**
 
• **Girija Devi **is also known as** 'The Queen of Thumri'.**
 
• **Thumri** is North India's most popular light-classical song form.
 
• It is developed during the** 19th century at the court of Lucknow's ruler Wajid Ali Shah.​**

**​ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shubha Mudgal **is an Indian singer of Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Gayatri Sankaran** is an Indian Carnatic musician and vocalist specializing in Carnatic vocals and violin performances. 
 
• **Rita Devis** is a Hindustani classical singer.

 

 

 

 

 

​ 

a1:T
